title: Jailed Brazil Beach Soccer Star Drawn Into Russia-US Spy Dispute

title: Managing $300B for Ultra Wealthy Families: Masters in Business with Holly MacDonald
summary: Barry speaks with Holly MacDonald, CEO of Bessemer Trust. They discuss her time working in Brazil and how investing in emerging markets shapes her investment philosophy. They also discuss the enduring strength of the US dollar, and how Bessemer evolved from a single family office to a $300 billion enterprise. They also discuss how they navigate building generational wealth and moderating family conflicts.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Emerging-Market Stocks Snag Best Week Since June on Tech Rebound
summary: Emerging-market stocks posted their biggest weekly gain since June as investors piled back into technology shares following a recent selloff, capping a volatile week across global markets.

title: Hungary Credit Outlook Lifted by S&P on Budget and Euro Ambition
summary: S&P Global Ratings lifted the outlook on Hungary’s sovereign debt to stable from negative, citing planned steps by Prime Minister Peter Magyar’s cabinet to cut the budget deficit and eventually adopt the euro.

title: Brazil’s Real Caps Best Week Since 2020 as Trabuco Lifts Mood
summary: Brazilian markets rallied after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva picked one of the nation’s most prominent bankers to be his finance minister, easing the worries about his economic policies that triggered a deep selloff after his surprise re-election last month.

title: Mexican Airport Operator GAP Raises $398 Million for Fibra Trust
summary: Mexican airport operator Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico SAB de CV raised 7.8 billion pesos ($398 million) for an energy and infrastructure trust, less than originally planned and following months of delays.

title: S&P 500 Has Best Week Since April 2025 on AI Rally: Markets Wrap
summary: Wall Street wrapped up a chaotic week with stocks climbing as a rebound in the artificial-intelligence trade gathered pace, reducing demand for Treasuries and haven currencies.

title: China Spurs Biggest Stock Gain Since 2024 on Rare Midday Vow
summary: Chinese authorities gave markets a boost with a rare midday statement pledging support, sending stocks to their best day in more than two years.

title: Colombia Peso Stumbles as Mounting Risks Test Rally
summary: The Colombian peso is headed for its worst month in more than four years as a toxic mix of trouble at home and abroad takes the shine off one of the year’s most resilient currencies.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 27
summary: Oil swung in thin trading as increasing attacks on energy infrastructure and tankers in the Middle East heightened supply fears.

title: Sánchez Seeks Unlikely Win With Plea for Spaniards to Go Vote
summary: Pedro Sánchez rallied voters to turn out in Sunday’s national election during his final campaign event, in a last-minute attempt to pull off an upset.

title: How Saks Is Reclaiming Luxury as Exemplar Luxury Group
summary: Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick reports on how Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly known as Saks Global, is reinventing itself for a fresh start in luxury since emerging from bankruptcy earlier this year. Exemplar Luxury Group CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck, FIT Associate Professor Shawn Grain Carter, Telsey Advisory Group CEO Dana Telsey, and Exemplary Luxury Group President and CCO Darcy Penick share their thoughts. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: ‘Dollar Storm:’ Greenback on Track for Longest Winning Run Since 2024
summary: The dollar climbed toward its longest monthly winning streak in two years as a rupture in the artificial intelligence trade and rising interest rates spur demand for safe-haven assets.

summary: Gold rose as a rally in stocks helped the precious metal recover from a rout that sent bullion prices to a 15-month low.

title: Treasuries Drop as Stock Rise Saps Demand for Haven Bonds
summary: US Treasuries fell as the market reopened after the Thanksgiving holiday, with gains in equities damping demand for haven assets.

title: Copper Surges Most in Seven Months as Risk Appetite Returns
summary: Copper climbed the most since April, extending its rebound from an 11-month low earlier this week, as risk appetite returned after a rout fueled by concerns over the artificial intelligence trade.

title: Trump’s AI Gambit Fuels Wild Thanksgiving Week on Wall Street
summary: The message from Washington this week was unmistakable: America must do whatever it takes to win the artificial-intelligence race with China, and the government is prepared to intervene to make it happen.

title: US Stocks Rebound as Traders Pile Into Battered Tech Shares
summary: US stocks rallied Friday, capping a week of whiplash as dip buyers scooped up some beaten down technology shares despite lingering worries about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence boom.

title: Power Outages, Flood Risks Linger as Storm Leaves East Coast
summary: More than 400,000 homes and businesses along the East Coast are without power after an explosive storm uprooted trees in Queens and Manhattan and inundated commuter rail lines in New Jersey on Thanksgiving Day.

title: Anthropic Shares Jump After Volatile First Week Since IPO
